name: stitchkit-consumer-node
comment: Node-facing declarations with every Node peer and no @types/bun. @types/json-schema is here because `@ai-sdk/provider` DEPENDS on the untyped `json-schema` and keeps its types a devDependency, so its published .d.ts references a module a consumer does not get — a Node consumer reading the agent-runtime declarations with skipLibCheck:false installs the types itself. Not our gap, but this fixture is where a Node consumer's experience is proven, so it reproduces the real fix rather than hiding the problem.
